title: Breach Outflow Hydrograph Source and Parameter Manifest

FRL.source: Central Water Commission (CWC) National Register of Large Dams (NRLD) & Tamil Nadu WRD Reservoir Records
FRL.exact_citation: Central Water Commission (2019/2024), Dam Safety Appraisal & Flood Forecasting Datum, Lower Bhavani Project (PIC: TN12HH0014)
FRL.limitations: Official operating full reservoir elevation datum above Mean Sea Level.

Vw.source: Central Water Commission (CWC) Hydrological Data Book 2020
Vw.exact_citation: CWC (2020), Hydrological Data Book (Southern Rivers Basin), Live Storage Capacity of Lower Bhavani Reservoir = 780.50 MCM (27.56 TMC)
Vw.limitations: Proxy volume corresponding to active live storage; actual volume released depends on real-time reservoir pool level at moment of hypothetical breach.

hw.parameter_name: Depth of Water Above Final Breach Invert (h_w)
hw.source: Tamil Nadu Water Resources Department (TNDWR) Operational Full Depth
hw.exact_citation: TNDWR Daily Reservoir Bulletin (Operational Full Depth = 105.0 ft = 32.004 m)
hw.limitations: Assumes water level at full depth with breach cutting down to riverbed foundation level.

hb.source: M3 Standard Hypothetical Failure Mode Definition
hb.exact_citation: JalRakshak-HD M3 Engineering Definition (h_b = 40.0 m earthen composite flank section)
hb.limitations: Hypothetical total breach cut height for earthen flank failure mode.

froehlich_1995_Qp.exact_citation: Froehlich, D. C. (1995). 'Embankment dam breach parameters revisited.' Water Resources Engineering, Proc. of the 1995 Conf., ASCE, San Antonio, Texas, pp. 887-891; also Wahl (1998) USBR DSO-98-004 p. 25, Eq. 2.
froehlich_1995_Qp.limitations: Empirical power-law regression calibrated on 22 dam failures (V_w up to 660 MCM, h_w up to 85 m). V_w = 780.5 MCM is slightly outside maximum calibration dataset (EXTRAPOLATION_PRESENT).

froehlich_1995_tf.exact_citation: Froehlich, D. C. (1995). 'Embankment dam breach parameters revisited.' ASCE; also Wahl (1998) USBR DSO-98-004 p. 25, Eq. 3.
froehlich_1995_tf.mapping_definition: Empirical breach formation time mapped to triangular screening hydrograph rise-time parameter; NOT measured hydrograph time-to-peak.
froehlich_1995_tf.limitations: Formation time regression evaluated for same-family diagnostic comparison; calibrated on 22 failure cases.

froehlich_2008_tf.exact_citation: Froehlich, D. C. (2008). 'Embankment Dam Breach Parameters and Their Uncertainties.' Journal of Hydraulic Engineering, ASCE, 134(12), 1708-1721.
froehlich_2008_tf.mapping_definition: Froehlich 2008 empirical breach formation time is being used as the rise-time parameter of the volume-constrained triangular screening hydrograph. It is NOT measured hydrograph time-to-peak.
froehlich_2008_tf.limitations: Calibrated on 74 historical dam failures with maximum V_w = 660 MCM. Extrapolated to 780.5 MCM (EXTRAPOLATION_NOTED).

macdonald_langridge_monopolis_1984_Qp.parameter_name: MacDonald & Langridge-Monopolis (1984) / Wahl (1998) Peak Flow Regression
macdonald_langridge_monopolis_1984_Qp.source: MacDonald & Langridge-Monopolis (1984) in SI units by Wahl (1998/2004)
macdonald_langridge_monopolis_1984_Qp.exact_citation: MacDonald, T. C., and Langridge-Monopolis, J. (1984). 'Breaching characteristics of dam failures.' J. Hydraul. Eng., ASCE, 110(5), 567-586; Wahl, T. L. (1998) USBR DSO-98-004 p. 26; Wahl, T. L. (2004) 'Uncertainty of Predictions of Embankment Dam Breach Parameters', ASCE JHE 130(5), Eq. 6.
macdonald_langridge_monopolis_1984_Qp.limitations: Enveloping empirical equation based on breach formation factor (V_w * h_w). Calibrated across 42 earth/rockfill dam failures. Used as upper-bound peak discharge sensitivity.
